## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, 0 → 10 T, 10 mT) and n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T, 20 mT)

Raw R(B) first (left), then the oscillatory part vs 1/B with the 4-fold filling factors of the nominal density marked, then the 1/B spectrum against the one-band Luttinger frequency F_L = |n|h/4e. **Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T):** clean SdH from ~1.4 T; the dominant tone is **30.0 T (0.91 F_L)** with its second harmonic at 60 T, plus a low tone at **7–8.6 T** and mixing products at 14 and 23 T (≈ 30 − k·7.5). Rxx climbs to 530 Ω across 7.7–9.7 T (one wide LL). Two frequencies at one density means either two Fermi surfaces (30 + ~8 ≈ 38 T would put n 15 % *above* the geometry-prior scale; 30 T alone puts it 9 % *below*) or a bunched-degeneracy sequence — a single point cannot separate a density-scale error from a band partition. **Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T):** dominant tone **12.3–12.9 T ≈ F_L** with a strong **5.3–6.6 T ≈ F_L/2** sub-tone (8-fold bunching at low B: deep minima near ν ≈ 16 and 24 with a broad maximum at ν ≈ 20) and, above 4 T, a fine sequence of period ≈ 0.02 T⁻¹ (≈ 50 T, i.e. fully lifted ν-step-1 levels). R(B → 0) = 53 / 148 Ω; T_sample 1.24 K on both; no leak (|I_gate| < 0.25 nA), no rail (≤ 12 % FS at 50 µV). **Take:** neither point is a stacking call; both say the fan is resolvable from ~1–1.5 T at the present T_e, and that the LL slopes of a fan (ν·e/h, capacitance-independent) are needed to pin the absolute n scale — the run-5 calibration fixes only c_bg/c_tg. Feeds plan step 4 (Landau fan at D = 0).

"""Runs 6/7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0: raw R(B), oscillatory part vs 1/B, tone read (FFT + sdh_onset) vs the 4-fold Luttinger frequency."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
spots = {6: +3.2, 7: -1.2}   # run id -> n (1e12 cm^-2) on the run-5 calibration
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
for k, (rid, n12) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid); print(summarize_run(r).splitlines()[0], "|", r.tags[0][:70])
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = r.col("sr1_X") / (r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6); T = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, T = B[o], R[o], T[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.2f}e12 -> F_L(4-fold) = {FL:.1f} T; R(B<0.35) = {np.median(R[B < 0.35]):.0f} Ohm, "
          f"R_max = {R.max():.0f} Ohm at {B[np.argmax(R)]:.2f} T; T_sample {T.mean():.3f} +- {T.std():.3f} K")
    ax[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[k, 0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.2f}e12, D = 0 - raw")
    m = B > 1.0; bg = np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax[k, 1].plot(1 / B[m], R[m] - bg, lw=0.7); ax[k, 1].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="dR (Ohm)", title="oscillatory part (deg-5 B-space bg, B > 1 T)")
    ytop = ax[k, 1].get_ylim()[1] * 0.85
    for nu in range(4, 41, 4):
        x = nu * 2.418e10 / (abs(n12) * 1e12)
        if 0.1 < x < 1: ax[k, 1].axvline(x, color="r" if nu % 8 == 0 else "0.6", ls=":", lw=0.6); ax[k, 1].text(x, ytop, str(nu), fontsize=6)
    for blo, c in ((1.5, "C0"), (3.0, "C1")):
        mm = B >= blo; f, sp = sdh_fft(R[mm][:, None], B[mm], nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False); sp = sp[0]; sel = (f > 2) & (f < 80)
        ax[k, 2].plot(f[sel], sp[sel] / sp[sel].max(), c, lw=1, label=f"{blo:.1f}-10 T")
        pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[sel], prominence=0.1 * sp[sel].max())
        print(f"  FFT {blo:.1f}-10 T peaks: " + ", ".join(f"{f[sel][p]:.1f} T ({sp[sel][p] / sp[sel].max():.2f})" for p in pk))
    ax[k, 2].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T"); ax[k, 2].axvline(FL / 2, color="g", ls=":", label="F_L/2"); ax[k, 2].axvline(FL / 4, color="g", ls=":", lw=0.6, label="F_L/4")
    ax[k, 2].set(xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="|FFT| (norm)", title="SdH spectrum in 1/B"); ax[k, 2].legend(fontsize=7)
    try:
        so = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
        print("  " + "\n  ".join(so.summary().splitlines()[:6]))
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("  sdh_onset:", e)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), B slow 0 → 10 T × (V_tg, V_bg) fast along the D = 0 line, n = −1.26 … +3.22×10¹²

> **05:28** · landau-fan D=0: (Vtg,Vbg) fast co-swept along D=0, n -1.26..+3.22e12 in 0.04 (113 pts), fast\_delay 1 s; B slow 0, 0.5, 1->10 T in 0.15 T (63 rows) ascending; sr1 100 uV (10 kOhm FS); ends at 10 T, gates 0 V · **ETA ~09:08** (≈3h40m)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`; E1 auto — in-envelope gates + field, no consent-gated knob touched). Runs 6/7 (ana) show resolvable SdH from ~1–1.5 T at both carrier signs but leave the tone content ambiguous at a single density (run 6: 30 T + ~8 T against F_L = 33 T — two bands, or a 9 % density-scale error). The fan separates these: Landau-level lines in the (n, B) plane have slope ν·e/h regardless of the capacitance scale, so their convergence on the CNP and their spacing give the **absolute n scale** (closing the c_tg = 9.5 nm prior), the **LL degeneracy sequence** from the CNP (ν = ±8 first gaps for a 16-fold zero-energy manifold; the pattern of higher gaps differs between one flat band and two interpenetrating ladders), and the per-column 1/B spectra give **F_i(n)** — one family (ABCA-like single Fermi surface), two with a fixed partition (ABAB light/heavy bilayer-like bands, F_h/F_l ≈ 2.6), or a Dirac + cubic pair (ABCB). **Fast axis:** (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5 D = 0 line (ratio 0.773, n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm), n from −1.26 to +3.22×10¹² in 0.04×10¹² (113 pts; V_tg −0.294 … +0.989 V, V_bg −0.487 … +1.174 V, clipped 5 mV inside the validators), hole → electron each row; `fast_delay` 1.0 s (run-5 calibrated, ~1.0 s/pt at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB — the filter leaves a 1–2-point lag along n that shifts every line's intercept by a constant and no slope; it is measured against run 5's CNP on the B = 0 row and corrected in analysis). **Slow axis:** B ascending from where the magnet sits (0 T): rows at 0 and 0.5 T (zero/low-field R(n) baselines), then 1.0 → 10.0 T in 0.15 T (61 rows, 63 total). A ν = 4 line moves 0.015×10¹² per row and ν = 40 moves 3.6 fast points, so every line is traceable; below 1 T the ν = 4 spacing is under 3 fast points and unresolved at this T_e anyway. **Coverage trade:** the hole side reaches only −1.26×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) against +3.22 on the electron side, so the degeneracy read is electron-side; D = 0 only — D ≠ 0 cuts are plan step 6b, riding the magnet down. **Sensitivity:** sr1 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS: the run-6/7 features (10–600 Ω) sit at 0.1–6 % FS and the readback resolves 10⁻⁴ FS; the ν = 0 CNP at high B may still rail — accepted, confined to |n| ≲ 0.2×10¹² on the high-B rows, and sr0 records the actual current so R = V/I stays valid off the clip. **Price** (run 5: 0.99 s/pt + ~8 s flyback per row; run 6: 3.1 s per field set + 0.137 T/min): 63 × (113 + 8 + 3) s + 10 T / 0.137 T/min = 3.4 h; with this session's 5–10 % overrun **≈ 3 h 40 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at 0 V**. **Checkpoints:** (1) row 0 (B = 0, ~3 min in): R(n) along D = 0 — CNP peak at n ≈ 0 with R ≈ 300 Ω (run 5: 297 Ω at (0.026, 0.033) V), no rail, |I_gate| < 1 nA, both channels live; (2) ~4 T (row ≈ 22, ~1 h 15 m): partial re-form — LL lines converging toward the CNP, family count, rail extent; (3) ~7 T (row ≈ 42, ~2 h 20 m): same, plus per-column spectra. **Abort** (`nb-collab interrupt`; the magnet then holds its last setpoint — re-read before the next move) on a leak trip (1 nA, in-cell), a rail over > 30 % of a row, T_sample drift > 0.3 K, or no LL structure by 4 T (would mean the fast-axis dwell smeared what runs 6/7 resolved — then a narrower fan at 2 s dwell).

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`): B slow 0 -> 10 T x (Vtg, Vbg) fast co-swept along D = 0 (run-5 cal), n = -1.26 .. +3.22e12 ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale = 9.5 nm prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.26, 3.2601, 0.04), 4)                 # 1e12 cm^-2, 0.04 steps (dVtg 11.5 mV, dVbg 14.8 mV per point)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
MARGIN = 0.005                                                        # stay 5 mV inside the validators (the raw grid's last point was 0.8 mV over TG_MAX)
keep = (Vtg_vec >= TG_MIN + MARGIN) & (Vtg_vec <= TG_MAX - MARGIN) & (Vbg_vec >= BG_MIN + MARGIN) & (Vbg_vec <= BG_MAX - MARGIN)
n_vec, Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = n_vec[keep], Vtg_vec[keep], Vbg_vec[keep]
assert len(n_vec) >= 100
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_vec.min() and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_vec.min() and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(_D_chk).max() < 1e-6 and np.allclose(_n_chk, n_vec, atol=1e-6)
print(f"fast axis: {len(n_vec)} pts along D = 0, n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 (0.04 steps); "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f} .. {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f} .. {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V (limits TG [{TG_MIN}, {TG_MAX}], BG [{BG_MIN}, {BG_MAX}])")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"gates now ({k_tg.volt():+.3f}, {k_bg.volt():+.3f}) V")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- slow axis: uniform-B ascending from where the magnet sits: 0 and 0.5 T baseline rows, then 1.0 -> 10.0 T in 0.15 T ---
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack(([0.0, 0.5], np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.15))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 5.0      # fast: run-5 calibrated (~1.0 s/pt at tau 0.3 s); slow: flyback settle + 10 tau at each row start
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Runs 6/7 features (10-600 Ohm) sit at 0.1-6 % FS;
# the nu = 0 CNP at high B may still rail -- accepted, confined to |n| < ~0.2e12 on the high-B rows (sr0 records the actual current).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T (0.15 T above 1 T); sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan: B slow 0, 0.5, 1 -> 10 T in 0.15 T ({len(B_vec)} rows) x (Vtg, Vbg) fast co-swept along D = 0, "
                  f"n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 in 0.04 ({len(n_vec)} pts); run-5 cal; Vsi = 0; sr1 100 uV; fast_delay 1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); '
              f'fast (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept hole -> electron, n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 in 0.04e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts); '
              f'slow B = 0, 0.5, 1.0 -> 10.0 T in 0.15 T ({len(B_vec)} rows), ascending; T_sample {_T0:.2f} K; Vsi = 0')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, magnet.field, sr1.X)      # live fan monitor only -- re-form from the TSV for any read

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)       # gates home; the field stays where the fan ended (10 T) -- the next step rides it down
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
